## Zvarr Gunsel (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 Zvarr alchemist (gun chemist) 6  
 N Medium humanoid (reptilian)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 13 (19 vs. beams and rays), flat-footed 12 (+1 armor [+6 vs. beams and rays], +3 Dex, +1 shield)  
 **hp** 54 (6d8++6)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +8, **Will** +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 20 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** bite +5 (1d4)  
 **Ranged** +1 pepperbox rifle +8 (1d10+4/x4) or mwk dragon pistol +8 (1d6/x4)  
 **Special Attacks** alchemical ordnance (10/day, DC 17, 3d6+7 and catch fire, 10-ft. radius), gun training 1 (pepperbox rifle), cartridge savant +2  
 **Alchemist Extracts Prepared** (CL 6th)  

  2nd—cat’s grace, cure moderate wounds, invisibility, see invisibility  
 1st—ant haul, expeditious retreat, jump, reduce person (DC 14), shield  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 10, **Dex** 16, **Con** 13, **Int** 18, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 17 Weapon Price Dmg (S) Dmg (M) Critical Range; **Weight Type** Special Razorang, Zvarr 15 gp 1d4 1d6 19-20/x3 30 ft. 3 lbs. S See text  
 **Feats** Extra Discovery (frost bomb), Extra Discovery (tanglefoot bomb), Gunsmithing, Rapid Reload (pepperbox rifle), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Deadly Aim](../../rules/feats/deadly-aim.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Deadly Aim needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +10, Appraise +10, Climb +10, Craft (alchemy) +13 (+19 to craft alchemical items), Disable Device +8, Fly +6 (+11 to glide or slow fall), Perception +9, Sleight of Hand +10, Spellcraft +13, Stealth +9, Use Magic Device +8; **Racial Modifiers** +1 Acrobatics, +2 Appraise, +1 Fly  
 **Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic, Dwarven  
 **SQ** alchemy (alchemy crafting +6, identify potions), mutagen (+4/–2, +2 natural, 60 minutes), discoveries (chemical stability, exploding bullet, explosive bomb, frost bomb, tanglefoot bomb), poison use, stretched wings (7 rounds), swift alchemy  
 **Combat Gear** +1 pepperbox rifle with 20 alchemical cartridges, masterwork dragon pistol with 10 alchemical cartridges (2 standard, 2 dragon’s breath, 2 entangling shot, 4 flares), 2 doses of hemochem; **Other Gear** red scatterlight suit, masterwork buckler, 20 gp
